text:
The purchaser likely prevails because the easement appurtenant passed with the house when the man conveyed it to the purchaser, even though the man never took actual possession and the purchaser only learned of it later. The easement remained of record and was not extinguished by the brief unity of ownership followed by conveyance. The man’s barricade therefore wrongfully interfered with the purchaser’s easement rights.  
CONFIDENCE: 85
